blocks.title: 📰 11. 🧠 REVISION
blocks.text: 🪝 February 2026 Rapid Recall & Key Milestones Summary. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: **Union Budget 2026-27**: Fiscal Deficit 4.3%, Capex ₹12.2L Cr (+9%), Income Tax Act 2025.
**16th Finance Commission**: Devolution 41%, 10% weight for GDP contribution.
**RBI Repo Rate**: Held at 5.25%; MSME collateral-free limit ₹20 Lakh; Fraud compensation cap ₹25,000.
**India-US Trade Deal**: US reciprocal tariffs cut to 18%; $500B US purchases.
**100% Insurance FDI (foreign direct investment with management stake)**: Operationalized via Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha Act 2025.
